name: m5-18-1
title: The scheduler's job and model
spec:
flowchart LR
  subgraph Queues["Scheduling queue"]
    AQ["activeQ (heap by priority/QueueSort)"]
    BQ["backoffQ (recently failed, exponential backoff)"]
    UQ["unschedulablePods (waiting for a cluster event that could help)"]
  end
  API["API server: new/updated Pods, Nodes, PVs, ..."] --> AQ
  AQ --> SC["Scheduling cycle (serial per pod)"]
  SC --> PF["PreFilter → Filter (nodes, parallel) → PostFilter (preemption if none fit)"]
  PF --> PS["PreScore → Score (parallel) → NormalizeScore → select best"]

  RS --> BC["Binding cycle (async): PreBind → Bind → PostBind"]
  BC --> API2["Binding written (spec.nodeName)"]
  SC -. "no node fits" .-> UQ
  UQ -. "relevant event (node added, pod deleted, ...)" .-> AQ

name: m5-19-1
title: Node lifecycle
spec:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Provisioned: bare metal/VM created (image, BMC/PXE or cloud API)
  Provisioned --> Configured: OS, kernel, drivers, runtime, kubelet (Ansible/image)
  Configured --> Validating: join cluster tainted "validating"
  Validating --> Ready: health gates pass (GPU diag, NCCL, network, storage)
  Ready --> Cordoned: maintenance or suspected fault
  Cordoned --> Draining: evict pods respecting PDBs/checkpoints
  Draining --> Maintenance: upgrade, repair, reboot
  Maintenance --> Validating: re-validate
  Draining --> Quarantined: validation failed → hardware repair queue
  Quarantined --> Provisioned: repaired/reimaged
  Ready --> Decommissioned: remove (RMA, scale-in)
  Decommissioned --> [*]

    SCHED["CFS/EEVDF scheduler, cpusets, NUMA, hugepages, OOM killer, PSI"]
  end

name: m5-29-1
title: Typical operator reconcile structure
spec:
flowchart TB
  EV["Event: CR created/updated/deleted OR owned object changed OR periodic resync"] --> RQ["Work queue (namespace/name)"]
  RQ --> R["Reconcile(request)"]
  R --> G["Get CR (cache); if gone → return"]
  G --> D{"deletionTimestamp set?"}
  D -- yes --> F["Run finalizer cleanup → remove finalizer → return"]
  D -- no --> FIN["Ensure finalizer present"]
  FIN --> V["Validate / default (defensive), resolve references"]
  V --> C["Compute desired children from spec"]
  C --> A["Create/patch/delete children (SSA or CreateOrUpdate), set ownerRefs"]
  A --> S["Observe actual state: children status, external systems"]
  S --> U["Update CR status.conditions, observedGeneration (status subresource)"]
  U --> RQR{"Needs requeue?"}
  RQR -- "error → backoff" --> RQ
  RQR -- "waiting on external → RequeueAfter" --> RQ
  RQR -- "done" --> END["return Result{}"]

name: m5-33-1
title: The ClusterPolicy flow
spec:
flowchart TB CP[(ClusterPolicy CR)] --> RC[ClusterPolicyReconciler.Reconcile] N[(Node events:
gpu.present, workload config,
OS label, upgrade labels)] --> RC DS[(Owned DaemonSets)] --> RC RC --> S{Singleton?
oldest CR wins} S -- other CR --> IG[Mark Ignored] S -- active --> INIT[init: discover GPU nodes,
runtime, OS, load states] INIT --> LOOP[For each state in order] LOOP --> ST[step: run control funcs
ServiceAccount, Role, ConfigMap,
DaemonSet, Service, ...] ST --> RDY{ready?} RDY -- yes or disabled --> LOOP RDY -- no --> MARK[remember not ready
continue to next state] MARK --> LOOP LOOP -- done --> OUT{any not ready?} OUT -- yes --> RQ[Set NotReady,
RequeueAfter 5s] OUT -- no --> OK[Set Ready condition]

name: m5-33-2
title: Node gating and the validator chain
spec:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Drv as driver pod
  participant Val as validator pod
  participant Tk as toolkit pod
  participant DP as device-plugin pod
  participant Kubelet
  Drv->>Drv: build and load nvidia kernel modules
  Val->>Val: driver-validation init loops until driver works
  Val->>Val: write driver-ready in run-nvidia-validations
  Tk->>Tk: init waits for driver-ready
  Tk->>Tk: install container toolkit and configure runtime
  Val->>Val: write toolkit-ready
  DP->>DP: init waits for toolkit-ready and live nvidia module
  DP->>Kubelet: register nvidia.com/gpu
  Val->>Val: run CUDA workload validation then write plugin-ready and cuda-ready

name: m5-35-2
title: Kueue MultiKueue (read from the Kueue docs and API types)
spec:
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as User
  participant M as Manager cluster (Kueue)
  participant W1 as Worker 1
  participant W2 as Worker 2
  U->>M: submit Job to LocalQueue
  M->>M: Workload gets QuotaReservation in ClusterQueue
  M->>W1: create remote Workload (dispatcher picks clusters)
  M->>W2: create remote Workload
  W2->>W2: admits the Workload
  M->>W1: delete remote Workload
  M->>W2: create copy of the Job labelled prebuilt-workload-name
  W2->>W2: run Job
  W2-->>M: status synced back to local Job
  M->>W2: delete remote objects when Workload Finished
